resolution: Count references in all workbook worksheets. A single reference changes its existing item; multiple references append a new item and change only the selected cell index. Update count/uniqueCount and invalidate only approved formula caches.

Existing PPTX run-preservation and duplicate-object identity rejection included in affected regression; these alone do not prove a text-search ambiguity negative control.
No packaged App GUI claim. r7 does not include DEV052/DEV053 JavaScript; next unified package pending.
